did: CLIPS-UI in the Nov 11 coordinator run: Studio's clips moved to frames kept on home, now that testing holds no media. #2870 made the clip index /2 (a walk names the sample home replays, an optional sha256) and holds clip-check to testing's six legacy frames. #2869 changed the steward rule so a session commits only clips/index.json and runs testing's guard before every push. #2871 lets a ref point to testing while asks are still read from some-ui and server. #2892 recorded calls C128 to C131. #2894 makes Studio's clip page read each frame from home through the paired link, in the Android build only: a frame home doesn't hold shows its label and why, and away from home the page lists the labels. Three reviews and CI reshaped #2894: frames came back as text until the phone asked for bytes, the web builds shipped native-only code until the frames moved to phone-only modules, and frames fought over the home link until they came one at a time, as a video's parts do.

calls.title: When testing's clip index moves to /2
options: keep it at /1 until every shipped reader reads /2
make the reader accept the new fields and move it now
move it now and let older builds show no Library until rebuilt
calls.why: Every build made before #2870 refuses /2 on its schema string alone, so a looser reader saves no build already in use, and both clips listed today are valid /1 as they are. Recorded as C131.
calls.undo: Mark testing#7 ready and merge it; builds older than #2870 then show no Library until rebuilt.

calls.title: What a clip frame home doesn't hold says
options: its label and why, told apart for a walk side and a session side
its label and one shared line
calls.why: A screen a session took is never kept, so saying home hasn't taken it yet would promise a frame that never comes. Recorded as C132.
calls.undo: Use one line for both in missing() in clip-frames.tsx and drop notKept from the clips words.

calls.title: What a clip's page shows away from home
options: testing's six legacy frames, and labels for the rest
nothing until the phone is paired
calls.why: A fallback would show some clips and not others for a reason the page couldn't state plainly, and those frames leave testing later anyway. Recorded as C133.
calls.undo: In ClipFrames, read a legacy frame from TESTING_DATA when the phone isn't paired.

left: testing#7, which moves clips/index.json to /2, stays a draft until the owner's APK, the Pages build and home's www image all carry #2870's reader.
#2895: on the clip page, a busy link reads as home not answering, frames appear only once all have come, and settled frames are fetched again on each visit.
